name: sheet
title: Sheet
description: A bottom sheet that rises over its nearest positioned ancestor: a modal dialog with a backdrop, a grab bar, a header of close or expand plus a centered title and optional Done, and a scrolling body. The drawer slides up from the bottom on open; SheetExpand interpolates height into a filled extra-details surface over the same ancestor. Pass modal={false} for a contained extra-details surface that leaves surrounding chrome reachable.
